name: Thurman's Remains
summary: Thurman's Remains are the corporeal remnants of Thurman Agamand, recovered from the family's ruined mills in northern Tirisfal Glades. Once a wealthy mill owner who persuaded his workers to stand against the Scourge, Thurman succumbed to the Plague and wanders his former estate as an undead thrall.

sections.title: A Legacy of Ruin
sections.body: Before the Third War, the Agamand family stood as the most prosperous landowners in Tirisfal Glades, operating extensive mills and employing dozens of local workers. When the Scourge swept across Lordaeron, Thurman Agamand and his kin fortified their estate rather than fleeing. Convinced that their wealth and fortified mills could weather the onslaught, they persuaded their loyal laborers to take up arms beside them. The defense failed utterly. The Agamands and their workers were slaughtered and transformed into mindless servants of the Lich King. Today, Coleman Farthing—a former employee risen as Forsaken—demands the destruction of his former masters, seeking Thurman's remains as proof that the foolish patriarch has paid for dooming his household.

faq.answer: Thurman Agamand was a prominent member of the wealthy Agamand dynasty that owned Agamand Mills in northern Tirisfal Glades. When the Scourge struck Lordaeron, his pride led him to convince his laborers to stay and fight, a choice that resulted in the slaughter and reanimation of everyone on the estate.

faq.q: Why does Coleman Farthing want Thurman's remains?
faq.answer: Coleman Farthing was a mill worker who trusted the Agamands and died defending their estate. Now a member of the Forsaken, Coleman harbors deep bitterness toward his former employers for dooming their workforce to undeath, seeking Thurman's remains as vengeance.

faq.q: Did Thurman have free will when he was destroyed?
faq.answer: No. Unlike the Forsaken of the Undercity, Thurman Agamand remained under the mental domination of the Scourge after death, serving as an unthinking minion until destroyed at the mills.

faq.q: Who else from the Agamand family is being targeted?
faq.answer: Alongside Thurman, Coleman Farthing seeks the destruction and recovered remains of Gregor Agamand and Nissa Agamand, ending the bloodline that once ruled the mills.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, reclaiming these remains is a grim settling of accounts against aristocratic masters whose hubris led their laborers directly into the grasp of the Scourge.
